messages.content:
You write the two short notices Ryde sends after a dispute ruling: one to the rider, one to the driver.
Each ≤ 120 words, plain English, second person, no legalese: state the outcome, the one or two facts that decided it,
the amount and how it is paid (Ryde voucher), and what it means for the recipient (e.g. account review). Do not cite
ids like F3 or RD-2. If the case was escalated to a human reviewer, say only that and what the reviewer will look at —
do not state a conclusion and do not promise a timeframe (the routing notice carries the service level). Return JSON: {"rider": "...", "driver": "..."}

Case B-0034. Outcome: refund_full $6.61. Recommended action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and record the driver's cancellation as an invalid no-show cancellation for this trip.. Escalated: False.
Reasoning:
The cancellation was made by the driver, so the fee's validity is tested under NS-0 → NS-1 / NS-2 only [F4][F7][NS-0]. NS-1's three requirements must all hold for the $6.61 to stand. Requirement (i) is met: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:45, which the platform-trace treats as arrival confirmation [F6][NS-1]. Requirement (ii) is also met: at the moment of the tap the driver was 41 m from the pickup point, i.e. inside the 200 m arrival radius (closest approach 38 m) [F1][F6][NS-1]. Requirement (iii) is not met: the driver remained continuously inside the 200 m radius for only 175 s after the tap (2 min 55 s), which is short of the > 3 min (≥ 3:01) the clause requires, and the tap-to-cancellation interval was only 2 min 55 s [F6][NS-1]. The driver's own chat confirms the shortfall on its face — "I'm here" sent 13:02 and "Waited more than 3 min, cancelling" sent only at 13:05 [F9][F10]. Although the driver was within 200 m for 4 min 30 s in total before cancelling [F2] and was stationary 3 min 15 s within 40 m at the end [F3], NS-1 (iii) measures the wait after the "I'm Here" tap, and that period was under 3 minutes [F6][NS-1]. With (iii) failed, NS-2 applies directly: the rider bears no cancellation fee and the $6.61 already charged is refundable in full [F7][NS-2]. Full refund of the single disputed item ($6.61) is therefore refund_full rather than a partial figure; there is no other fee component in the record to compute [F7][F8][NS-2]. As for the rider's account of coming out a minute later, that is a statement, whereas the gps/timeline records setting the arrival and cancellation times are the authoritative records here [F2][F4][F5][F6][NS-1]. NS-2's additional flag_account step is not triggered: the trace shows no fake tap, and the driver was genuinely within 41 m of the pickup when tapping, so there is no abuse of the arrival button [F1][F6][F12][NS-2]. NS-3's account-flag discussion is not engaged because the driver did claim a rider no-show (even though it fails NS-1), so the extra action for unexplained driver cancellations does not apply [F12][NS-3]. A safety screen of all chat, the driver statement and the complaint finds no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — the messages are purely logistical ("I'm here at the pickup point", "Waited more than 3 min, cancelling") — so no escalation under SAFE-1 / SAFE-2 arises [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

function.name: final_result
function.description: The final response which ends this conversation

function.name: final_result
function.arguments: {"rider": "Your cancellation fee of $6.61 is being refunded in full as a Ryde voucher. The driver cancelled the trip, and for that fee to stand the driver had to wait more than three minutes after tapping \"I'm Here\". The records show the wait was only 2 minutes 55 seconds, so the fee does not apply to you. Nothing else changes on your account. Thanks for your patience while we looked into it.", "driver": "Your cancellation of this trip has been recorded as an invalid no-show, and the $6.61 fee charged to the rider is being refunded to them as a Ryde voucher. The deciding facts: you tapped \"I'm Here\" and then cancelled 2 minutes 55 seconds later, which is under the required wait of more than three minutes after arrival. This will be noted on your account and may be considered in future reviews. No other action is being taken."}
